title: Create a single local “project folder” export for all program files

requirements.text: Add a delivery script that gathers/copies the entire repository into a single local "project folder" so the user can place all program files into one directory on their computer in one command (excluding .git, node_modules, dist/build, .dfx, and existing exports).

quotes: Move all the program files to project folder

acceptanceCriteria: A new script exists under frontend/delivery/ that creates a single folder containing the whole project (one top-level directory)
The script excludes the same directories already excluded by frontend/delivery/export-zip.sh (.git, node_modules, dist, build, .dfx, frontend/delivery/exports, etc.)
Running the script twice does not corrupt previous exports (either creates a timestamped folder or cleanly overwrites a dedicated output folder)
The script prints the final on-disk path of the generated project folder using English-only output

requirements.text: Update the delivery documentation to clearly explain how to create the single project folder and (optionally) how to create the ZIP, including exact commands to run from the repository root and where the output will be located on disk.

quotes: Move all the program files to project folder

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/delivery/README.md includes complete, properly formatted instructions (no truncated code blocks)
Docs include: command(s) to run, expected output location, and what to do next to run the app locally (install dependencies + start dev server)
All user-facing text in the updated docs is in English

requirements.text: Ensure the existing ZIP export continues to produce an archive that contains exactly one top-level folder with all program files, and that the console output is English-only (remove emoji-only cues if present).

quotes: Move all the program files to project folder

acceptanceCriteria: The resulting ZIP contains a single top-level directory (no files at the ZIP root)
The script prints the full output ZIP path at the end

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any code under frontend/src/components/ui (immutable paths).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor; do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Generating or hosting an online download link for the ZIP (the system cannot host files).
Running the website or scripts on behalf of the user from within chat.
